info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Education Enrollments Create-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Batch Insertion API facilitates the streamlined creation of multiple education enrollments in a single operation. This API is designed for educational institutions and administrators looking to efficiently manage large datasets of student enrollments. By allowing batch inserts, it enhances productivity and reduces the potential for errors compared to individual submissions. Typical consumers include school management systems and enrollment platforms that require bulk processing of student data.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new enrollment record in the system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully register an enrollment.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new enrollment. This JSON object should contain all the necessary information required to register a new enrollment, including user details and course information.
